shortDescription.default: eSignature - request, sign and track signatures on documents inside SharePoint

longDescription.default: Send PDF and Word documents from SharePoint for electronic signature. Multiple signers in sequential, parallel or mixed order, drag-and-drop signature/initials/date/name/text/checkbox fields, draw/type/upload signatures, decline and delegate, reminders and expiry, templates, a full audit trail with a certificate of completion and SHA-256 tamper evidence, and signed copies saved back to SharePoint. Runs entirely inside SharePoint: no Azure app registration and no third-party signing service.

features.title: eSignature Feature
features.description: Adds the eSignature web part and the Request signature library command.
